codeReview.summary: The migration cleanly renames and types the three foundational modules (error-constants, errors, utils) while preserving CommonJS runtime behavior and expected exports. The diff is primarily type-annotation work with no material functional regressions identified, and the handoff verification evidence matches feature expectations.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The feature description's dependency note is incorrect and can mislead workers about migration order.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: features.json:425 says 'utils.js imports from errors.js' and prescribes error-constants -> errors -> utils; handoff notes the opposite in 2026-03-11T03-32-04-593Z__core-foundations__a943fe99-c5c9-402d-9160-df463e3ca656.json:52 ('errors.js actually imports from utils.js ... correct dependency order is error-constants -> utils -> errors').

sharedStateObservations.observation: Library architecture notes are stale about compilation behavior and can cause confusion during migration work.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/architecture.md:37 says 'No compilation step currently (tsconfig is noEmit check-only)', but .factory/services.yaml:3 defines 'compile: npx tsc' and this mission relies on emitted lib/*.js outputs.
